purpose: Local exploratory optimization after the five user-run official Q4 records; no official simulator access
development_stage_1: cell_development_21000: five paired layouts, smooth error field, baseline25/cells/context/interleave/opscan
development_stage_2: task_development_22000: five new paired layouts, smooth error field, baseline25/context/resume25/share25
selection_rule: Among context/resume25/share25 with every stage-2 full-clear and independent audit passing, select the lowest stage-2 mean total virtual time. Evaluate that single research candidate even if baseline is faster. Stage-1 results remain development evidence, not holdout.

holdout.independence: Two error fields reuse one source layout; average paired differences by layout before counting independent layout outcomes.

stress: The existing ten constructed stress layouts under plus_one/minus_one/checker_one; correctness evidence only, excluded from performance means.

minimum_evidence_for_recommending_replac.interpretation: An advance decision rule for this small local experiment, not a mathematical guarantee or contest standard. Passing it still does not establish an official score.

target_400: A research reference only. The competing approximately 400-second result has unknown question, clearance rate and averaging method. Local means below 400 are not official target attainment.
runtime: Report actual solver wall time separately from virtual task cost. Preserve frozen launchers during this research.
